title: Revive Us Again
lyrics_original: For the Son of Thy love,
Who hath shown us our Savior,
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who hath borne all our sins,
To the God of all grace,
Who hast brought us, and sought us,
Fill each heart with Thy love;

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible love You showed us through Jesus Christ, who died for us and now reigns in glory. Thank You for sending Your Holy Spirit to illuminate our hearts and reveal the beauty of our Savior. Lord, we ask that You touch our hearts today and revive us again. Refresh our spirits, restore our joy, and draw us closer to You as we give You all the praise.

devotional.reflection_english: True spiritual renewal begins when we lift our eyes to praise the Father for the ultimate gift of His Son. Jesus’ sacrifice on the cross and victorious resurrection opened the way for us to experience God's overflowing grace. Through the Holy Spirit, our hearts are awakened to see the beauty of our Savior clearly once again. As we sing this hymn of praise, let us invite the Lord to refresh our weary souls and reignite a passionate joy in His presence.
